classes.name: HLRAppli_ReflectLines
classes.summary: This class builds reflect lines on a shape according to the axes of view defined by user. Reflect lines are represented by edges in 3d.

instanceMethods.name: SetAxes
instanceMethods.signature: (Nx: number, Ny: number, Nz: number, XAt: number, YAt: number, ZAt: number, XUp: number, YUp: number, ZUp: number): void
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the normal to the plane of visualisation, the coordinates of the view point and the coordinates of the vertical direction vector.

instanceMethods.name: GetResult
instanceMethods.comment: returns resulting compound of reflect lines represented by edges in 3d

instanceMethods.name: GetCompoundOf3dEdges
instanceMethods.signature: (type_: HLRBRep_TypeOfResultingEdge, visible: boolean, In3d: boolean): TopoDS_Shape
instanceMethods.comment: returns resulting compound of lines of specified type and visibility represented by edges in 3d or 2d
